attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Time Providers (T1547.003)
attackers_goals: Gain persistence using the legitimate Windows time provider mechanism, which loads libraries into Windows services.
description: The endpoint time provider has been tampered, this change may be used to gain persistence on the host by loading libraries into the time management service.
investigative_actions: Verify if the registered library is malicious. Check if the software performing the installation is a malicious binary. Check for any network activity from a "svchost.exe -k LocalService" process that seems suspicious.
name: Suspicious time provider registered
